title: Bali Video Engine Capability Matrix (Step 5C)
engine_version_audited: Blueprint 1.2 / Composer V3 / Overlay Engine 3C.1 / Multimodal 4C

capabilities.current_engine_capability: Presenter video fullscreen timeline playback without overlay
capabilities.notes: Directly supported via Blueprint 1.2 visual_timeline with presenter asset or full video pass-through.

capabilities.current_engine_capability: Extended visual segment duration in visual_timeline
capabilities.notes: Supported by maintaining existing image/video item duration across multiple spoken beats.

capabilities.editorial_intent: SWITCH to Property Photo (Hero or Sequential)
capabilities.current_engine_capability: Property photo ingestion (4B.2) + Ken Burns pan/zoom in Composer V3
capabilities.notes: Fully supported via Blueprint 1.2 visual_timeline image items with deterministic Ken Burns animation.

capabilities.editorial_intent: SWITCH to Property Video B-roll (Hero or Sequential)
capabilities.current_engine_capability: Property video segmentation (4A.1) + exact 1:1 trim (source_in_ms / source_out_ms)
capabilities.notes: Fully supported in Composer V3 with strict timeline-to-source duration matching.

capabilities.current_engine_capability: Canonical audio track separation (voice master preserved over visual_timeline)
capabilities.notes: Fully supported in Composer V3; audio track is independent of visual cuts.

capabilities.current_engine_capability: Lip-synced PIP window with custom or preset geometry, border, rounded rect
capabilities.notes: Fully supported in Composer V3 via pip.windows array and collision validator.

capabilities.current_engine_capability: TTF font metrics text-wrapped drawtext filter with safe area compliance
capabilities.notes: Fully supported via captions array in Blueprint 1.1 / 1.2.
Single string location tag supported; styling governed by editing style presets.

capabilities.editorial_intent: Hero Financial Information Card (Multi-field structured terms)
capabilities.current_engine_capability: Overlay engine currently supports single text string per overlay item
capabilities.notes: Requires Design Resolution and minor engine extension: multi-line/multi-field structured card (R$350k + MCMV + Entrada R$60-70k + Parcelas R$2.000).

capabilities.editorial_intent: Minimal CTA End Card / Button Badge
capabilities.notes: Basic banner supported; dedicated branded button badge / end card is a design system extension.

capabilities.editorial_intent: Presenter Punch-in (Subtle reframing without source cut)
capabilities.current_engine_capability: Composer supports scale/crop per visual item, but dynamic zoom on continuous video requires segment split
capabilities.notes: Can be executed by splitting presenter video timeline item and applying scale transform.

capabilities.editorial_intent: Verified Location Proof (Geographic proximity / route / POI)
capabilities.current_engine_capability: Engine manages internal property media pool only; no external POI/map sourcing system exists
capabilities.notes: Engine can render location video/photo IF provided in media pool, but lacks automated external geographic sourcing.

capabilities.current_engine_capability: Overlays bound to exact start_ms / end_ms time windows
capabilities.notes: Fully supported; overlay cleanly ends at specified timestamp.
